meta.name: chain-binding
meta.description: Language-neutral expected verifier outcomes for the envelope-to-chain binding rules (spec/chain.md 'Empty chains', spec/envelope.md field rules, spec/chain.md 'Unknown members'). A chain with ZERO events is legal — the weakest honest shape (template/draft) — and then manifest.first_event_hash, envelope.first_event_hash and envelope.entry_hash MUST all be null; capsule_id derives with 32 zero bytes standing in for first_event_hash_raw. A capsule claiming any chain anchor while carrying no events is lying about its own bytes and MUST fail closed: in a plain capsule those anchors are the only envelope-to-chain binding. Verifiers MUST report machine-readably that a zero-event chain was not walked (expected.notes_includes). Separately, the per-event hash preimage is rebuilt from the STORED line: an event omitting the optional untrusted_payload_fields member MUST verify — re-serializing a typed projection injects the default and spuriously fails an intact chain.
meta.no_warranty: Conformance fixtures only; not production templates or advice.

vectors.name: empty-chain-null-anchors
vectors.note: Positive control: zero events, all three anchor claims null, originator-signed with a signer commitment. Absence of history is a weaker claim made honestly; the verifier reports that no events were walked — as the empty_chain_not_walked qualifier on the verdict (spec/results.md; the fact's first uniform typed surface) — rather than rendering an unqualified pass.

vectors.name: empty-chain-claimed-anchors

expected.error_includes: must be null when the chain has no events

vectors.note: Zero events but manifest + envelope claim anchors (internally consistent, so capsule_id derivation and every hash check pass). The empty-chain null-anchor rule is the ONLY thing standing between this capsule and a PASS — a verifier that treats an empty chain as 'nothing to check' verifies an envelope bound to nothing.

vectors.name: event-without-untrusted-fields
vectors.note: One event whose stored bytes omit the optional untrusted_payload_fields member. The event hash commits to JCS(stored line minus hash); a verifier that recomputes from a re-serialized typed projection injects 'untrusted_payload_fields':[] and reports a spurious hash mismatch on an intact chain.
